### KEGG

The data frame with unique KEGG entries is stored as an excel file. Identifier
columns that are not used when mapping to KEGG pathways are removed for clarity.

```{r write IDs suitable for analysis with KEGG, echo=FALSE, results='markup',tidy=TRUE}

xlfile.KEGG.unique_cleaned <- xlfile.KEGG.unique %>%
  select(
    -any_of(c(
      "KEGG ID",
      "KEGG ML",
      "InChI ML",
      "InChI mzC",
      "InChI",
      "ChemSpider ML",
      "HMDB ML",
      "InChIKey ML",
      "InChIKey mzC",
      "InChIKey"
    ))
  )


cat("###START###\n")
cat("Nr. of rows KEGG:", nrow(xlfile.KEGG.unique_cleaned), "\n")
cat("###END###\n")

KEGG_path <- paste0(KEGG, "/", user, "_KEGG_pathway.xlsx")
write_xlsx(xlfile.KEGG.unique_cleaned, path = KEGG_path )
```
